QUOTE: MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY off (default) └─ expands to libc calloc / free [platform.h ~163-168]
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that in the default build (MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY off) the `mbedtls_calloc` and `mbedtls_free` macros expand directly to libc `calloc`/`free`, and it says earlier that they are macros in platform.h.
